rationale: Pins the third override-resolution tier, `first-parent-guess` (confidence 0.5), which no fixture exercised. Reachable from a single file: the declaring ancestor only has to be absent from THIS file, so the gap was in the fixture lane, not a property of the tier. The positive case asserts the guess edge and its `reasonCode`; the forbid asserts the documented NEGATIVE — an un-annotated method of a different arity must produce no guess at all, because guessing there would fabricate an override that is really an overload. Measured error rate on grails-core: 15 of 49 verifiable guesses (30.6%) name a method their target does not declare, which is why `reasonCode` is asserted rather than left implicit in a magic 0.5.
